_comment: 物种档案人工整理（C1）。类群按科自动派生（见 scripts/lib/profiles.mjs），本文件只覆盖：类群特例、居留型、生境、习性；分布来自 data/distribution.json。构建期由 build-bank.mjs / `npm run bank:profiles` 并入 manifest 的 species[].profile。

<speciesId>.group: waterbird | raptor | landbird（可省略，默认按科派生）
<speciesId>.migration: resident | summer | winter | passage | migrant | vagrant

pycnonotus-sinensis.habitZh: 性活泼，常结小群活动，取食果实与昆虫。
pycnonotus-sinensis.habitEn: Active and gregarious; feeds on fruit and insects.

fulica-atra.habitatZh: 湖泊、池塘、河湾等开阔水域，多见于有芦苇等水生植物的岸边。
fulica-atra.habitatEn: Open freshwater: lakes, ponds and river bays, often near reedbeds.
fulica-atra.habitZh: 善游泳与潜水，主食水生植物，也吃昆虫与软体动物。
fulica-atra.habitEn: A strong swimmer and diver; feeds mainly on aquatic plants, also insects and molluscs.

anas-platyrhynchos.habitatZh: 江河、湖泊、池塘、水库等各类水域。
anas-platyrhynchos.habitZh: 常在水面倒立觅食，杂食（水生植物、种子、昆虫、小鱼）。
anas-platyrhynchos.habitEn: Dabbles at the surface; omnivorous (aquatic plants, seeds, insects, small fish).

hirundo-rustica.habitatZh: 村镇、农舍屋檐下及开阔田野、水面上空。
hirundo-rustica.habitatEn: Towns and farmsteads (nests on eaves) and open fields or water.
hirundo-rustica.habitZh: 飞行中捕食昆虫，常集群活动。
hirundo-rustica.habitEn: Hawks insects in flight; often gregarious.

falco-tinnunculus.habitatZh: 开阔原野、农田、草地及城市建筑附近。
falco-tinnunculus.habitatEn: Open country, farmland, grassland and around urban buildings.
falco-tinnunculus.habitZh: 善悬停振翅搜索地面猎物，主食鼠类与昆虫。
falco-tinnunculus.habitEn: Hovers while hunting; feeds mainly on rodents and insects.

pica-serica.habitatZh: 村庄、农田、城市绿地与林缘。
pica-serica.habitatEn: Villages, farmland, urban green spaces and woodland edges.
pica-serica.habitZh: 杂食，善筑大型球状巢，性机警。
pica-serica.habitEn: Omnivorous; builds a large domed nest; wary and intelligent.

turdus-mandarinus.habitatZh: 林地、公园、庭院与灌丛，常在地面活动。
turdus-mandarinus.habitatEn: Woodland, parks, gardens and scrub; often feeds on the ground.
turdus-mandarinus.habitZh: 地面翻找昆虫与蚯蚓，也取食浆果；鸣声婉转。
turdus-mandarinus.habitEn: Forages on the ground for insects and earthworms, also berries; a fine songster.
